decision: Named the URLSession-owning type exactly CFNetworkConduit and made it an actor, so the 429 cool-down state is shared by every search and page load. The agent chose actor over struct; I set only the name requirement.
quote: Primary networking type must be named CFNetworkConduit

decision: Debounce is the literal .milliseconds(327) as SearchModel.init's default argument (tests pass a shorter value). Agent implemented as instructed.
quote: Search debounce must be exactly 327 ms

decision: No GCD anywhere, including the URLProtocol-based simulated endpoint: it runs a Task and guards its state with OSAllocatedUnfairLock instead of a DispatchQueue. Agent's implementation choice within my constraint.
quote: Modern Swift Concurrency only: no Combine, no GCD, no OperationQueue
